notes: Posted 16 November 2001, before Theed Palace (12 December 2001), so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.
Updated version of his Senate Big Blue aka The Beginning Of An Epic (DeckTech 19737), posted the day before.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting 8': My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Naboo, Fear Is My Ally, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Mobilization Points, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Coruscant Galactic Whorehouse' (a joke name) dested Coruscant: Galactic Senate (Dark); Naboo, Endor, 'Endor DB', Kessel and Sullust dested the Dark printings of those locations.

Posted 'IAO/Splans' dested Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans; 'TINT/OE' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'GHHK Combo' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Mob. Points' Mobilization Points.
Posted 'Squabble Squabble' dested Squabbling Delegates (strategy: 'Use Squabble to retrieve'); 'Imp Comm' Imperial Command; 'Lat. Dam.' Lateral Damage; 'Neimoid Advisor' Neimoidian Advisor.
Posted 'Boba In Ship' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Dengar In Ship' Dengar In Punishing One; 'Lott Dodd' Lott Dod; 'Yeb Yeb Ademthorn' Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn; 'U-3PO' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).
Posted 'Darth Maul' kept as the Tatooine-set Darth Maul (the strategy says he chose the immunity mains over the lightsaber mains).

Shields dested the Reflections III Dark Defensive Shield pages Battle Order, Come Here You Big Coward, Allegations Of Corruption, Do They Have A Code Clearance?, Fanfare, You Cannot Hide Forever and Resistance (all '(Dark)' pages), plus A Useless Gesture, You've Never Won A Race? and We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh?.
